dedupe_keys.name: cartographie informative des zones inondables cizi obstacle

description: Cartographie informative des zones inondables (CIZI) - obstacle is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by drealmp.net. This lot consists of linear objects materializing obstacles to flow. Obstacles are considered to be levees, dikes and embankments, i.e. any linear accumulation of land generally derived from building materials, embossed on the floodplain and intended to protect it or part of it from rising water levels. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Informative mapping of floodplains (CIZI) - obstacle" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Données vecteur. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://adelie.application.developpement-durable.gouv.fr/condition.do?convention=diffusion_public). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
